quarterly_data.quarter: IonQ press release: IonQ Advances to Final Stage of DARPA's Quantum (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IonQ advanced to Stage C of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative after completing Stages A and B: IonQ and DARPA signed a Stage C agreement with a potential value of up to $300 million, running through 2029, under which IonQ will deliver multiple generations of its Superion quantum systems for DARPA's independent verification and validation; funding beyond the initial obligation remains subject to future appropriations and DARPA funding actions. IonQ says it is among the first companies selected for Stage C.
quarterly_data.figure: potential value up to $300 million; Stage C through 2029
